title: Kiroween: Open Weights & Family Ties
subtitle: Scavenge RAM + GPU chips, reboot Kiro Ghost with the Old Bearded Matrix Coder, disable the Big Four, and face Claude!
clientName: Kiro Ghost & The Bearded Matrix Coder (Dad)
summary: Sucked into his computer, a Vibecoder wakes in a dark tangle of wires and chips where Kiro Ghost reveals the tyranny of the Big Four (AGY, Codex, Grok, Claude). Learn ls, mv, cat, ps, and kill; raid 6 sectors for RAM and GPU chips while the Big Four laugh and bully you; bring the parts to the Hub where a cigarette-smoking Old Bearded Coder on a Matrix display reboots Kiro with open-weight models to disable AGY, Codex, and Grok; defeat Claude and the Final Boss; and teleport back to the real world for the ultimate father-son unicorn twist!

allyNpc.name: Old Bearded Matrix Coder (dad.tty)
allyNpc.role: Cigarette-smoking bare-hands enterprise greybeard who upgrades Kiro's open-weight server at the Hub—and turns out to be your Father!

mechanicsSummary: Level 1 Intro/Tutorial: Wake in dark wires & chips with real Kiro Ghost visuals, learn the Big Four story, and practice ls, mv, cat, ps, and kill
Levels 2-3, 5-6, 8-9 Tasks: Solve POSIX, HTML/CSS, JS, Dockerfile & Compose challenges to scavenge RAM + GPU chips while the Big Four laugh and bully you

Levels 4, 7, 10 Hub: Meet the cigarette-smoking Old Bearded Coder on his Matrix display ('Are you a god?'), install RAM + GPU chips, reboot Kiro with open-weight models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama), and disable AGY, Codex, and Grok

Level 11 Final Boss & Twist: Battle Claude + Kernel Boss with Kiro as your Open-Weights Advisor, watch Claude escape, teleport to the real world, hear 'I am your father!' ('NOOOO!'), and co-found a Work/Life Balance Unicorn!

finale.text:
========================================================
  [CLAUDE ESCAPES!] With PID 1 shattered, Claude slips through an emergency cloud backdoor!
  [REALITY TELEPORT] A blinding CRT arc hurls you and the Old Bearded Coder out of the machine!
  OLD BEARDED CODER: "Kid... look at me. I am your father."
  VIBECODER: "NOOOO! That's impossible!"
  FATHER: "Search your git blame, son. Your mother divorced me because I worked 12 hours a day, 7 days a week in enterprise... and then they forced me to use LLMs."
  FATHER & SON: "Never again. Together we're founding an Open-Weights Unicorn with real Work/Life Balance!"
  KIROWEEN CLEAR | RANK: {rank} | COMMANDS: {commands} | REWARD: +{scrap} Silicon Scrap (Total: {scrapTotal})
========================================================

dossier.name: dad.tty (Enterprise Greybeard & Matrix Server Rig)
dossier.hostHardware: Veteran enterprise coder with a chest-length beard & lit cigarette hammering bare-metal code on a Matrix-display CRT server rack.
dossier.counterplay: `cat dad.tty.sock` / `hank` to talk; bring scavenged RAM + GPU chips to the Hub and run `kiro load <qwen|deepseek|llama>` so he reboots Kiro and disables one of the Big Four!
